events.name: Bash
events.head: Check pass.py usage and where the Tantra key field lives in admin
events.input: $ python3 workshop-plan/tasks/pass.py 2>&1 | head -30; grep -n "sys.argv\|def cmd_\|def set_\|FIELDS\|ALLOWED" workshop-plan/tasks/pass.py | head -30; grep -rn "Tantra Messaging\|Session Reminders" cloud/src | cut -c1-220 | head -12

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find settable fields in pass.py and the admin section names
events.input: $ grep -n "argv\|startswith(\"\|'spec'\|\"spec\"\|needs_from_owner\|title" workshop-plan/tasks/pass.py | cut -c1-170 | head -40; echo ---; grep -rn "Tantra Messaging\|Session Reminders" cloud/src cloud/public 2>/dev/null | cut -c1-260 | head -12

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read the admin reminders section, key storage, and pass.py set logic
events.input: $ sed -n 320,345p cloud/public/admin/admin.js | cut -c1-400; echo ---; grep -rn -i "tantra_key\|tantra_api_key\|tantraKey" cloud/src cloud/public/admin | cut -c1-200 | head -15; echo ---; sed -n 425,470p workshop-plan/tasks/pass.py | cut -c1-200; git log --oneline -5 -- cloud/public/admin/admin.js

events.name: Bash
events.head: Locate the Tantra key field wording in admin and pass.py set handler
events.input: $ sed -n 325,336p cloud/public/admin/admin.js | cut -c1-600 | grep -n -i -o ".\{120\}tantra.\{160\}" | head -8; echo ---; grep -rn -i -o ".\{60\}tantra[a-z_ ]*key.\{80\}" cloud/src/index.ts cloud/src/connectors/stack.ts cloud/public/admin/admin.js | cut -c1-260 | head -12; echo ---; grep -n "def set_task\|def cmd_set\|for k, v in kv\|kv\[" workshop-plan/tasks/pass.py | head

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read pass.py set fields, admin sign-in route, and welcome key usage
events.input: $ sed -n 548,566p workshop-plan/tasks/pass.py | cut -c1-220; echo ---; grep -n -o ".\{80\}admin/enter.\{160\}" cloud/src/index.ts | cut -c1-330 | head -6; echo ---; grep -rn -o "enrolWelcome.\{0,100\}\|tantra_key.\{0,80\}" cloud/src/*.ts cloud/src/connectors/*.ts | cut -c1-200 | head -12

events.text: Checking how the admin sign-in and the welcome email use the key on disk, so the rewritten ask for Adi points at the real field.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find admin sign-in route and which modules read the stored Tantra key
events.input: $ grep -rn -o ".\{60\}/admin/enter.\{120\}" cloud/src cloud/public/admin 2>/dev/null | cut -c1-300 | head -6; echo ---; grep -rn -l "loadTantraKey\|tantra_key_enc\|tantraKey(" cloud/src | head; grep -rn -o "export async function [a-zA-Z]*Tantra[a-zA-Z]*\|enrolWelcome[^;]\{0,60\}" cloud/src | cut -c1-200 | head -10

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check admin sign-in path, welcome code, and the two parent tasks' current asks
events.input: $ grep -rn -o ".\{50\}admin/enter.\{100\}" cloud --include=*.ts --include=*.js --include=*.html --include=*.py -h 2>/dev/null | grep -v node_modules | cut -c1-260 | head -5; echo ---; grep -rn -i -o ".\{40\}welcome.\{60\}" cloud/src/reminders.ts cloud/src/nurture.ts cloud/src/lane.ts | cut -c1-200 | head -6; echo ---; python3 - <<'E'

events.name: Bash
events.head: Confirm how the admin sign-in works now and T-228's latest note
events.input: $ grep -rn -o '.\{70\}admin/enter.\{110\}' cloud/src cloud/public | cut -c1-280 | head -5; echo ---; git show 0365f09 --stat | head -8; git show 0365f09 | grep -n "^+.*enter" | cut -c1-200 | head -5; echo ---; python3 - <<'E'
